title: Property Play: Coldwell Banker’s CEO on how AI and SpaceX money will hit home prices
raw_text:
Property Play: Coldwell Banker’s CEO on how AI and SpaceX money will hit home prices
CNBC Property Play brings you interviews with some of the biggest names in real estate, touching on everything from commercial and residential to finance and the mortgage markets, innovation in the industry and the growing risk to assets and operations from climate change.
CNBC's Diana Olick sits down with Kamini Lane, CEO of Coldwell Banker Realty, who says millions of dollars in new wealth generated by AI and the recent SpaceX IPO have yet to flow through to residential real estate, but it's coming. Hear how and where she expects it to hit and how she's navigating her company through the AI revolution.
Watch the full interview, and sign up to receive the weekly Property Play newsletter, straight to your inbox.
